races.name: £9 Racedays At Nottingham Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Peace And Quiet

runners_data.name: Lean d'Aislingean

runners_data.name: Lucky Camino
runners_data.note: Palmer three-year-old making debut, solid trainer record with newcomers but another complete unknown

runners_data.name: Adamlyi
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who showed class when second at Newbury last time, strong Haggas/Marquand combination

runners_data.name: Revelio
runners_data.note: Limited ability but consistent prominent runner, will ensure honest pace if tracking the leader

runners_data.name: Moreedd
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse from powerful Varian stable, modest form but could benefit if strong pace develops

runners_data.name: Atlas Mountain
runners_data.note: Another closer who has shown glimpses, needs the race to unfold to suit his come-from-behind style

runners_data.name: Carly Minogue
runners_data.note: Long absence of 336 days is major concern, but has shown ability at this level when fresh previously

runners_data.name: Mr Bollinger
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who stays well, needs pace to aim at but form suggests he's just a plodder

races.paceDynamic: Runman will likely lead with his proven front-running ability, but the presence of several prominent racers like Adamlyi, Revelio, and Carly Minogue could create early pressure and force a stronger pace than ideal. The three unknown quantities (Peace And Quiet, Lean d'Aislingean, Lucky Camino) add tactical uncertainty, while hold-up horses like Moreedd, Atlas Mountain, and Mr Bollinger will be looking to capitalize from off the pace. With multiple prominent runners likely to track or challenge Runman early, this should develop into a genuinely run race that will favor horses with a finishing kick over pure speed merchants.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Genuine Pace Favours Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Adamlyi and Revelio track Runman closely creating honest fractions
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will find out the front-runners late and set up perfectly for the hold-up brigade to strike. Moreedd from Varian and Atlas Mountain can use their finishing speed to maximum effect.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Runman gets an uncontested lead with the prominent horses settling behind
scenarios.body: He can dictate comfortable fractions and prove too tough when the challenges come, with his winning form giving him the edge. Adamlyi's class could see him emerge best of the chasers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses all decide to sit and the early pace becomes pedestrian
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where raw ability matters most, suiting the higher-rated newcomers. Peace And Quiet's OR 120 rating and unknown ceiling could prove decisive in a slow-run affair.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Chaos Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the three newcomers cause positional problems and disrupt the expected pace flow
scenarios.body: The established runners get caught in traffic or tactical trouble, allowing a horse like Carly Minogue to benefit from the confusion despite her long absence. Atlas Mountain could also profit from a muddled contest.

watchPoints.text: Watch for Runman getting too keen if multiple horses track him closely early, as he may not have faced sustained pressure before
Monitor the three newcomers (Peace And Quiet, Lean d'Aislingean, Lucky Camino) for market moves indicating stable confidence
Check if any of the hold-up horses (Moreedd, Atlas Mountain, Mr Bollinger) get trapped wide or behind wall of horses
Observe early pace development - if it becomes pedestrian the higher-rated newcomers become much more dangerous
Watch for Adamlyi's positioning as he represents the main form threat to the favourite if getting competitive race to aim at

races.paceDynamic: Knights Charge will lead unchallenged with no other confirmed pace-setters, setting a steady tempo that won't stretch this 11-runner field early. The prominent runners Outflank and Domenico Contarini may press forward but lack early speed, while the majority of runners adopt hold-up tactics including the three highest-rated horses Liam Mera Kai, Cloud Forest and Zurna. This creates a tactical race with minimal early pressure, building to a sustained finish from the 3-furlong pole. The race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and closers who can produce late kicks, as they'll get ideal racing room and a target to aim at in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closers Dominate Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Knights Charge maintains a steady gallop without serious pressure through halfway
scenarios.body: The pace will be genuine but not fierce, setting up perfectly for the higher-rated hold-up horses to unleash finishing kicks. Liam Mera Kai and Bay Royale can time their runs to perfection with Rossa Ryan and Pierre-Louis Jamin's tactical expertise.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Running Success
scenarios.trigger: If Knights Charge gets soft fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: With most rivals adopting waiting tactics, Knights Charge could steal a march entering the straight and prove hard to peg back. The lack of early pace pressure allows Ray Dawson to dictate terms throughout.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Unknown Quantities Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Cloud Forest or Zurna possess untapped ability from their Godolphin/lightly-raced profiles
scenarios.body: The tactical nature suits unexposed types who can quicken late under Oisin Murphy's guidance or benefit from the Birkett yard's patient approach. Their lack of exposed form becomes an advantage in this competitive handicap.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Mid-Division Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and prominent runners get first run
scenarios.body: Outflank could benefit from Luke Catton's claim and the Gosden polish, while a tactical ride sees him closer than usual. The bunched finish favours horses positioned just off the early pace.

watchPoints.text: Knights Charge dictating a crawling pace early could set up a sprint finish that negates stamina advantages
Liam Mera Kai showing rustiness after 88 days off despite having conditions in his favour
Cloud Forest and Zurna being supported in betting despite limited public form
Bay Royale's position early as he needs cover but Pierre-Louis Jamin must find racing room
Outflank getting a good pitch just behind Knights Charge to utilise Luke Catton's claim effectively

races.paceDynamic: Stepanov is the only confirmed front-runner and will take them along at a steady tempo without pressure from the break. The prominent runners Sports Day, Grindleton and Labiche will track just behind but none are natural pressers, allowing Stepanov to control the fractions. With most of the field comprising hold-up horses including Premier Cru, Houndswood Willow, Thimble, Aurelune, Veld and Tenison, the race will develop into a tactical affair before a sprint finish. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses who can position off the steady pace and unleash their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the steady pace allows hold-up runners to position perfectly for their finishing kicks
scenarios.body: The patient tactics pay dividends as the closers sweep past a tiring Stepanov in the final furlong. Premium positions go to those with the best turn of foot from off the pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can get first run on the field while others are still organising
scenarios.body: Sports Day or Grindleton steal a march turning for home and hold on as the hold-up horses make their moves too late. The tactical advantage of racing closer to the pace proves decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Stepanov wires the field
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runner's sustainable pace proves too honest for the hold-up brigade to reel in
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up horses find Stepanov has built an unassailable lead and their finishing efforts fall short. Sometimes front-running tactics triumph when others overthink the pace scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise from the back
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes messy with prominent horses interfering with each other
scenarios.body: A rank outsider from the rear finds clear running while the fancied horses get caught up in traffic problems. Racing luck trumps form analysis in a scrambled finish.

watchPoints.text: Stepanov could get an uncontested lead if the prominent horses fail to track him closely enough through the early stages
The large field of hold-up horses may create traffic problems in the straight when they all try to make their moves simultaneously
Sports Day's ability to quicken from his prominent position could be crucial if he can get first run on the field
Premier Cru needs clear running room given his hold-up style and David Egan will require luck in running from the back
Watch for any early scrimmaging between the prominent horses that could hand Stepanov an easier lead than expected

races.paceDynamic: Island Bear will take the field along as the sole confirmed front runner, but faces immediate pressure from four prominent runners (Capichera, Rosa Inglesa, Beyond The Bar, North Force) all wanting similar positions early. This congestion behind the leader creates a moderate pace with tactical shuffling through the first half mile. The critical phase comes 2-3 furlongs out when the prominent pack starts to jostle for racing room, likely creating a messy finish where positioning matters more than raw ability. This race shape strongly favours horses with tactical speed who can secure clear runs, giving the edge to prominent runners with smart jockeys over hold-up horses who may struggle for daylight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace stays controlled and Island Bear doesn't kick clear
scenarios.body: The prominent pack gets first run on the leader with North Force and Rosa Inglesa benefiting from their recent form edge. Chapter's hold-up style becomes a liability in the inevitable traffic jam.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Escapes
scenarios.trigger: If Island Bear gets soft fractions and the prominent runners hesitate
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage while the chasers mark each other, with Tom Marquand timing his move perfectly. Only horses with finishing kick like Chapter can respond but it's too late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong with multiple runners pressing Island Bear
scenarios.body: The pace collapses in the final furlong allowing Chapter to sweep up from the rear despite traffic concerns. Domination also benefits from the strong gallop suiting her recent win.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites get tangled up in traffic and positioning goes wrong
scenarios.body: Beyond The Bar or Runswick find clear water while others are still scrimmaging, with their class edge telling late. The pace dynamics create the perfect storm for an unexpected winner.

watchPoints.text: Watch for early interference as Capichera, Rosa Inglesa, Beyond The Bar and North Force all converge behind Island Bear in the first two furlongs
Monitor Chapter's position turning for home - if caught wide or behind a wall of horses the 206-day absence becomes irrelevant
Island Bear's jumping and pace judgement crucial early - if pressed hard by multiple prominent runners the race will set up for closers
North Force's recent 15-day turnaround could be either perfect timing or slight concern depending on how he travels in the early stages
Watch Domination's claimer Joanna Mason for tactical awareness - the 5lb allowance is valuable but positioning will determine everything

races.paceDynamic: Stella Lucente and Ziata will contest the early lead, with Stella Lucente looking the more assured pace-setter given her consistent front-running style and 12-day freshness advantage over Ziata's 29-day break. The dual speed will create an honest gallop from the start, preventing the race from becoming a sprint finish. With multiple hold-up horses including Wondrous Light, Jamie Sommers, and Saliko needing the pace to unfold, the early tempo suits those racing prominently. This pace dynamic clearly favours prominent racers and front-runners who can capitalize on the genuine early gallop without getting into a speed duel.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Honest Pace Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Stella Lucente and Ziata settle into a sustainable rhythm after the initial skirmishing
scenarios.body: The even tempo allows the pace-setters to stay in contention while preventing the hold-up horses from unleashing their customary finishing kicks. Prominent racers like Espanita and Pretty Spirited can track the leaders without excessive early effort.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Speed Duel Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Stella Lucente and Ziata engage in a prolonged battle through the first half-mile
scenarios.body: Both front-runners weaken significantly in the final furlong, creating opportunities for the strongest finishers with proven stamina. The honest early pace sets up perfectly for hold-up horses with tactical speed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Stella Lucente gets an uncontested lead with Ziata settling behind
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows Stella Lucente to dictate fractions and kick clear when challenged, with Oisin Murphy's tactical awareness proving decisive. Her consistent front-running form translates perfectly to this scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Midrace Tactical Move
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent racers like Espanita and Volendam make sustained moves approaching the home turn
scenarios.body: This creates a new pace injection that catches both the leaders and hold-up horses at the wrong moment. Those racing in the second rank can capitalize on superior positioning and race fitness.

watchPoints.text: Ziata could race too keenly if pressured early by Stella Lucente, compromising her stamina reserves
Jamie Sommers applying blinkers for first time could create unpredictable early positioning or over-racing
Huggable returning from 200-day absence needs watching for market confidence and visual sharpness
Saliko's 25-day break following moderate last effort requires monitoring for race readiness
Watch for any late market moves on Wondrous Light given recent winning form and proven hold-up style

races.paceDynamic: Dunnington Lad is the only confirmed front-runner but won't be pressured early, setting a comfortable tempo. Six horses want prominent positions (Bang On The Bell, Irish Dancer, Timebar, Nad Alshiba Snow, Charging Bull, Barmyblade, Poetic Jack) creating significant congestion behind the leader. This cluster will create traffic problems and positional battles from 3f out as they fan wide seeking racing room. The uncontested lead and inevitable prominent scramble strongly favours either the lone leader or patient hold-up horses who can avoid the traffic and deliver late challenges.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Dunnington Lad gets an easy lead and maintains galloping room turning for home
scenarios.body: The 6-year-old can dictate fractions without pressure and kick clear before the prominent pack sorts itself out. His recent 12-day break keeps him sharp while others get tangled up behind him.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horses Swoop Late
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent cluster creates the expected traffic jam from 3f out
scenarios.body: Patient hold-up types like Sonic Si and Masterclass can pick their way through or around the scrimmaging pack. Their clean runs and late kicks prove decisive when the prominent horses compromise each other.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Survivor Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If one prominent runner secures the ideal stalking position without getting boxed
scenarios.body: Irish Dancer or Bang On The Bell finds the perfect spot in second or third, avoiding the worst congestion. They can strike approaching the final furlong while others are still finding daylight.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Dunnington Lad stops suddenly and the prominent battle becomes chaotic
scenarios.body: The entire pace structure falls apart with no sustainable tempo, creating a messy sprint from halfway. Any horse with tactical speed can capitalize on the confusion.
